title: Vertical or horizontal bars for the longest rivers?
description: The longest river on each continent is to be put in a table and drawn as a bar graph. A river's length lies along the ground, like distances on Earth, so horizontal bars suit it. The table and the graph are left for the child to research and draw.
teaching_notes: One idea: a length that lies along the ground is best drawn with horizontal bars, and the longest bar belongs to the longest river. Watch for students who think only one direction is allowed, because vertical bars would also work.

video_script.why: The child picks vertical or horizontal bars for the lengths of rivers using the reason of the solved example, and plans the table and the graph to research.
video_script.substitution: The lengths of the longest rivers take the place of the heights of the mountains.
video_script.anchor: the longest river of each continent, to be put in a table and drawn as bars
video_script.payoff_line: Use horizontal bars, because the length of a river lies along the ground

final_answer.value: Horizontal bars (a river's length lies along the ground); vertical also possible. Table, graph and continents are for the child to research.
final_answer.spoken: use horizontal bars, because the length of a river lies along the ground; vertical bars are also possible, and the table, the graph and the continents are for you to find out

maths_rules: the length of a river lies along the ground, so it is a length parallel to the ground
lengths parallel to the ground, such as distances on Earth, are best drawn with horizontal bars
vertical bars would also show the lengths, but horizontal bars suggest the lengths better
the table has one row for each continent, with the longest river and its length; the child finds these facts
check: the longest bar must belong to the longest river, and the bars start from zero
no river facts are given in this video, so no length is stated
video_script.design: The rivers are set beside the mountains of the solved example. The reason is that bars should lie the way the thing is measured, and the facts of the table are left for the child to find.
open_questions: The question asks the child to find the river facts, make the table and the graph, and name the continents with the longest rivers. The video gives only the choice of bars and the plan, and states no river length.
